name: transport-resource-throughput-unleashed
title: Transported resource throughput · 1 Gbps policy
summary: Relay the identical transported-resource workload with both relay TCP interfaces explicitly configured for the 1 Gbps MTU tier.
notes: Controlled computational comparison: identical transported link and driver, with only TCP bitrate policy changed.
description: The transported-resource relay workload repeated with both relay TCP interfaces explicitly configured for 1 Gbps, selecting the 524,288-byte MTU tier. The fixed wire driver establishes one genuine transported link before timing and then drives balanced full-duplex LINK/DATA frames in RESOURCE context. This isolates the large-frame switching ceiling from the default policy most deployments use.
conformance: A valid transported link is established before timing; every issued LINK/RESOURCE frame is forwarded once, in order and byte-exact, in both directions, with exact directional payload totals and zero missing, duplicate, corrupt, reordered, unexpected, or timed-out frames.
